title: Fix practice time not incrementing and lines learned not showing
description: User listened to song for several minutes but practice time shows 0/15min. User marked 2 lines as learned but they don't appear anywhere on dashboard. The logPractice mutation may not be called, or dashboard queries aren't fetching the data.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Practice time increments while audio is playing
Dashboard shows accumulated practice time for today
Lines marked as learned appear in dashboard stats
Verify logPractice mutation is being called with time data
Verify lineProgress data is queried on dashboard
Add 'Lines Learned' stat to dashboard if missing
